item: Row J post-keyword patch: coordination clusters and server-location clusters count outlets, and the card audit names the count
summary: The corpus coordination clusters count distinct outlets (two feeds of one site repeating a story are one voice) and the server-location layer counts distinct outlets per country and per shared server address (two feeds of one site on one host are no longer a shared-hosting cluster). The card audit's distinct_evidence_sources is renamed distinct_evidence_outlets and the leads alias is removed. The outlet-count scan drops its named limit. Closes the two named limits of Row J's OPEN_QUEUE item (2) (queries.corpus_coordination, queries.server_locations); the card_audit field rename follows. The OPEN_QUEUE entry's text is updated with the held OPEN_QUEUE rewrite, not in this PR, because that file belongs to another open PR; this row is the record until then. Not measured: the cost of the outlet lookup in these two queries.
